The '''E-5 blaster rifle''' was a basic, light, cheap, and fragile [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] manufactured by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]]. Being the the standard-issue armament of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], it was produced by the millions in the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], in particular during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
[[File:E-5_blaster_rifle.jpg|thumb|left|250px|An E-5 blaster]]
The E-5 was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] characterized by its short barrel. At the bottom of the weapon was the handle, at the front end of which the trigger and a trigger guard were located.<ref name="FF104" /> Minimal and single pressure on the trigger permitted continuous fire.<ref name="FF104" /><ref name="E1TVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] [[Blaster gas canister/Legends|cartridge]] was located at the rear end of the weapon while the [[Blaster power pack/Legends|power pack]] was inserted on the left side.<ref name="E1TVD" /> A waste energy conduit was attached to the top of the barrel to remove excess heat from the barrel and gas-charging chamber, limiting overheating. The weapon was made of detachable modules that could be replaced.<ref name="FF104" /> The barrel itself was interchangeable and could be changed with broad-fire pattern tip.<ref name="E1TVD" /> The E-5 usually fired red blaster bolts.<ref name="TPM" /> It could be fired in space<ref name="TCW-RM">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> and underwater as well.<ref name="CW5">{{CW|5}}</ref>

The E-5 blaster was developed to be used by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] with minimum processing. The handle was designed for the three-fingered hand of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] but the weapon could also easily be used by [[Species/Legends|organics]] such as [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. B1 battle droids were programmed to use the weapon with their two hands but the light and small-sized blaster could also be fired with one hand.<ref name="FF104" />

[[File:B1SeriesBattleDroid-WitchesOfTheMist.png|thumb|right|175px|A B1 battle droid aims his E-5]]
The E-5 [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] rifle originated as a [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[E-series]] blaster design that was reverse-engineered by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]] for the needs of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Ultimately, the E-5 was a very basic and light-weight blaster rifle. Hence, it was developed to be manufactured with light raw materials. The objective of the Trade Federation was to reduce the costs of production and to augment the number of weapons transportable. This made the E-5 quite fragile but its detachable modules could readily be removed to be repaired or replaced. Beyond economic considerations, the light and cheap design of the E-5 blaster favored mass-production and permitted its production to be easily moved to any industrial plant. Despite these flaws,<ref name="FF104" /> the E-5 was a very accurate rifle,<ref name="CCG" /> though battle droids were usually not capable of precise shots. In addition, the blaster was designed to be attached to a B1 droid [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]], the usual form of storage in the compressed form of the battle droid in transit.<ref name="FF104" />

==History==
[[File:Obi-Wan_force_pull.jpg|thumb|left|240px|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] using [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force pull]] on an E-5 blaster rifle]]
The E-5 [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] rifle was developed by Baktoid Armor Workshop on order from the Trade Federation prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. The objective of the Federation was to provide a light, cheap and easy-to-use weapon for its [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]].<ref name="FF104" /> During the conflict on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the E-5 rifle was the primary weapon worn by the B1-series and [[OOM-series battle droid/Legends|OOM-series battle droid]] of the Trade Federation.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref><ref name="FF104" /> The production of E-5 blaster rifles was then moved from the Baktoid premises to [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="FF104" />

[[File:Battle_couple_on_Geonosis.png|thumb|right|240px|Padmé using an E-5 during the first battle of Geonosis.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Baktoid Armor Workshop manufactured E-5 blasters for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as the weapon was still massively used by the B1 battle droids.<ref name="FF104" /> The weapon also equipped [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]],<ref name="SWE">{{SWE|technology|commandodroid|commando droid}}</ref> [[Rocket battle droid/Legends|rocket battle droid]],<ref name="TCW-RM" /> [[droid marine]]s,<ref name="BFII" /> and [[Tactical droid/Legends|tactical droids]].<ref name="Hasbro-Tactical">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=Armored Scout Tank with Tactical Droid|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWDLXAST-Tactical.asp}}</ref> Beyond droids, the E-5 blaster rifle was used by organic troops, such as the [[Neimoidian Home Defense Legion/Legends|Neimoidian Home Defense Legion]],<ref name="Insider71">{{InsiderCite|71|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:10:05 Edition}}</ref> the [[Koorivar Fusiliers/Legends|Koorivar Fusiliers]] and the [[Gossam Commandos/Legends|Gossam Commandos]]<ref name="Insider76">{{InsiderCite|76|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:3:21 Edition}}</ref> In the first months of the Clone Wars, Baktoid also introduced a shorter and lighter version of the E-5 rifle, the [[E5 blaster carbine]] to equip vehicle crews and rear-echelon droids.<ref name="SoT" /> Nevertheless, the E-5 blaster rifle remained widely used until the end of the conflict.<ref name="TCWts">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref><ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref> Even after the Clone Wars, the E-5 rifle was still in service among battle droids of the [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]].<ref name="BFII" />

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[C-21 Highsinger/Legends|C-21 Highsinger]] used an modified E-5 during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Bounty">{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}}</ref> [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]]'s [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirates]] also made use of this modified weapon, particularly [[Gwarm/Legends|Gwarm]].<ref name="ANB">{{TCW|A Necessary Bond}}</ref>

E-5 blaster rifle were also used by [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droids]] during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Hasbro-IG86">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2008 Basic Figure|pack=#18: IG-86 (Assassin Droid)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW18IG86.asp}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Fandex-B1BattleDroid.png|thumb|left|250px|A B1 battle droid holds an E-5]]
The E-5 blaster rifle first appeared in {{Film|I}} as the weapon that equipped the Trade Federation battle droids.<ref name="TPM" /> It was later identified as E-5 blaster by ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]''.<ref name="FF104" /> Although many sources described the weapon as a blaster riffle,<ref name="TNEGtWaT" /><ref name="E1TVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref><ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Coruscant Limited|cardname=Battle Droid Blaster Rifle}}</ref> the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and its [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook|''Saga Edition'']] identified the weapon as a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]].<ref name="A&EG">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref> In addition, the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' introduced an [[E5 blaster carbine|E5 carbine]] that was virtually identical to the E-5 blaster rifle, but without specifying whether it was intended to be the same or a different weapon.<ref name="SWG:E5C">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=item|E5 Carbine}}</ref> Finally, the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Trading Card Game]] clarified that the E5 carbine was a shortened version of the E-5 rifle.<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=E5 Carbine}}</ref> The sourcebook [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']] later developed some historical background for the difference between the two weapons.<ref name="SoT" />

In ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'', the [[Shotgun/Legends|shotguns]] of engineer droids, the [[Bulldog RLR]] of the [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]], and the [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] used by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] use the same model as the E-5 blaster rifle.<ref name="BFII" />
